scope: Independent closing read-only review of duplicate/late pg owner errors during lane retirement and client release

review.finding: Persistent error handler precedes lock query and remains while executor closes; repeated errors stop this worker without losing listener coverage.
Pool release synchronously installs idle handler; owner then removes only its own listener. No asynchronous listener gap is introduced.
Runtime-checked concrete Client.end is awaited while handler remains, then release(true) discards rather than pools. Close failure retains handler/client and sets fatal stop.
Executor close failure aborts same worker, retains owner and listener, refuses reuse, and makes stop reject.

quarantineBoundary.healthySession: A still-live retained advisory session continues to hold the database lock until backend termination or connection loss.
quarantineBoundary.alreadyLostSession: A dead PostgreSQL session releases its advisory lock externally. Same-process stop, retained error handler and fatal shutdown are guaranteed; global exclusion of another backend owner is not guaranteed once this session is lost.
quarantineBoundary.publication: Existing owner_token, lease, stopping signal, principal and dependency checks remain unchanged; this review does not claim a new global durable quarantine mechanism.

limitations: Actual restored-target PostgreSQL termination qualification remains a separate owner scope.
No original database-content audit or full-plant claim.
